vocales.style: Happy children's educational song, cheerful female singer, ukulele and hand claps, slow clear tempo, simple catchy melody, kids choir on the chorus

lyrics: A de avión que vuela alto
I de iguana en la rama
O de oso que se abraza
U de uva dulce y rica
The vowels, I sing them too!
A is for apple, red and round
E for elephant, big and loud
I for insect, small and quick
O for octopus in the sea
U for umbrella in the rain
Now I know my vowels, yahoo!
Sing them with me, you can too!

numeros.style: Bouncy children's counting song, friendly female singer, piano and tambourine, counting clearly from one to ten, cheerful and energetic

lyrics: Cuatro, cinco, seis, ¡no voy a parar!
Siete, ocho, nueve, ¡casi llego al fin!
Un sol, dos manos, tres pollitos
One, two, three, let's count with me!
Four, five, six, as easy as can be!
Seven, eight, nine, almost at the end!
One sun, two hands, three little chicks
Four paws, five fingers, six balloons
And ten big hugs for you!
